newsitem.title: USA: Excel to sell parking brake business.
newsitem.headline: Excel to sell parking brake business.

text.p: Excel Industries Inc said Monday it signed a non-binding letter of intent to sell its automotive parking brake business to Dura Automotive Systems Inc for an undisclosed amount of cash.
The product line was acquired when Excel purchased Anderson Industries in April 1996, it added. It contributed about $12 million of sales to Excel last year, less than two percent of total sales.
Excel said Chrysler Corp and General Motors Corp are the key customers.

"In assessing our market position, we believe our resources must be concentrated in those areas where Excel can be the number one or two supplier," James Futterknecht Jr., chief executive, said in a statement. "While we have a decent share of the market, we believe that growth potential is not commensurate with the resources that will be required to support the buisness in the future."
Excel supplies window, door and seating systems, recreational vehicle (RV) appliances, and injection-molded parts to the automotive, heavy truck, RV and bus industries.
